## Hutijin (CR 22)

**XP** 615,000  
LE Large outsider (devil, evil, extraplanar, lawful)  
**Init** +11; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., detect good, detect magic, see invisibility, see in darkness; Perception +37  


**Defense**


**AC** 44, touch 26, flat-footed 36 (+1 dodge, +7 Dex, +18 natural, +9 profane, –1 size)  
**hp** 396 (22d10+176); regeneration 10 (good, silver)  
**Fort** +15, **Ref** +20, **Will** +23  
**DR** 20/good and silver; **Immune** fire, poison; **Resist** acid 10, cold 10; **SR** 33  


**Offense**


**Speed** 50 ft., fly 100 ft. (average)  
**Melee** +4 unholy flaming burst trident +39/+34/+29/+24 (2d6+17/19–20 plus 1d6 fire)  
**Ranged** net of snaring +28 (grapple)  
**Space** 10 ft.; **Reach** 10 ft.  
**Special Attacks** fear  
**Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 20th)  

Constant—detect good, detect magic, see invisibility  
At will—animate dead, blasphemy (DC 26), create undead, fireball (DC 22), greater dispel magic, greater invisibility (DC 23), greater scrying (DC 26), greater teleport (self plus 50 pounds of objects only), magic circle against good, mass hold monster (DC 28), polymorph, power word stun, produce flame, ray of enfeeblement, scorching ray, shocking grasp, suggestion (DC 22), tongues, trap the soul (DC 27), unhallow (DC 24), unholy aura (DC 27), unholy blight (DC 23), wall of fire  
2/day—heal, summon (level 9, 2d10 lemures, 2d4 ice devils or erinyes, 1d4 barbed devils, or 1d2 pit fiends 100%)  
1/day—symbol of persuasion (DC 25), meteor swarm (DC 28)  


**Tactics**


Hutijin prefers to summon devils to deal with interlopers or adversaries, rather than waste time fighting them in melee. However, if pressed into combat, he fights with his trident, all the while peppering his foes with fireballs.  


**Statistics**


**Str** 37, **Dex** 24, **Con** 27, **Int** 27, **Wis** 27, **Cha** 29  
**Base Atk** +22; **CMB** +36; **CMD** 63  
**Feats** Alertness, Cleave, Great Cleave, Improved Critical (trident), Improved Initiative, Improved Vital Strike, Iron Will, Quicken Spell-Like Ability (fireball), Vital Strike, Weapon Focus (trident), [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Dodgility.*  
**Skills** Appraise +30, Bluff +34, Diplomacy +34, Disguise +31, Fly +30, Intimidate +34, Knowledge (arcana) +30, Knowledge (planes) +33, Knowledge (religion) +30, Perception +37, Sense Motive +37, Spellcraft +33, Stealth +28, Survival +33  
**Languages** Abyssal, Celestial, Common, Draconic, Giant, Goblin, Infernal, Sylvan; telepathy 100 ft.  
**Gear** +4 unholy flaming burst trident, net of snaring  


**Special Abilities**


**Fear (Su)** Hutijin can cause fear by speaking (this is a free action). Creatures within 30 feet that hear his voice must succeed on a DC 30 Will save or be affected as though by a fear spell (CL 20th). A creature that successfully saves cannot be affected again by Hutijin’s fear ability for one day. The save DC is Charisma-based.  


**Ecology**


**Environment** any (Hell)  
**Organization** solitary or troupe (Hutijin plus 3–6 ice devils and 1-2 pit fiends)  
**Treasure** double standard
